6444.title: Inherited agent-directory environment survives bridge startup
6444.rootCauseOneLine: The registry env is an overlay, not the final child environment: RuntimeProviderProcessManager merges sanitized inherited process.env first, which retains PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR.

prReviews.verdict: Unnecessary for the claimed daemon inheritance failure
prReviews.topFinding: Static diff only: adding this non-BB environment variable to the declaration is redundant for inheritance; the changed declaration-list assertion does not exercise the child spawn boundary.

6444.proposedFix: No production change is justified by this report. Investigate daemon launch-time environment or later Pi behavior if a real deployment still fails.
6444.caveats: Two clean trusted checkouts ran a real bridge worker with the scripted-echo fixture and Pi declaration. No live Pi model session or enrolled daemon was used. Initial full builds lacked SDK dist; explicit SDK build/build:types and focused Turbo runs succeeded.
